body.purpose: Default reading text across the app.

dos: Do build every color from semantic tokens; the only hex values in app UI are the two validated chart blues.
Do keep body-text contrast at or above 4.5:1 in both themes; the observed pairs (body, muted, primary-on-white-text, destructive) all pass.
Do grow touch targets on coarse pointers using the established pattern; the floor is a full 44px for any new control.
Do gate entrance animation behind reduced-motion checks and always leave a no-JS, no-animation path that shows content
Do keep the skip-link target (id="conteudo") on exactly one content landmark per route layout.
donts: Don't hardcode gray, white, or black utilities in app UI; illustration fills and email templates are the only sanctioned exceptions.
Don't set gradient text on functional headings or metrics; the vitrine hero title is the single exception.
Don't build a second chart series on the --chart-* tokens; they are dead, all-gray, and the lightest is near-invisible on white.
Don't nest landmarks (a main inside a main) or label plain paragraphs and divs with aria-label; assistive technology ignores both.
Don't add new overlay scrim opacities; unify the existing dialog/sheet pair first.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, used rarely and always meaningfully.
Administrative density for admins; single-action clarity for participants.
Flat surfaces at rest; motion only in response to state.
Readable pt-BR copy; no invented claims, no decorative text effects on functional UI.
narrative.overview: The interface is the committee's worktable: a calm, legible surface where an administrator runs collective decisions and a participant answers them. Nothing decorates; everything records. Density serves the admin screens (reports, member lists, catalog editing) while participant screens (voting, doubts, RSVP) stay scannable with one action per view. The mood is claro e acolhedor: light surfaces, generous whitespace, plain pt-BR copy, and a single indigo voice that speaks only when something needs deciding. A playful Claymorphism direction with rounded toy-like forms was explicitly considered and rejected; the system stays a restrained shadcn-style interface.

rules.body: The indigo accent appears on ≤10% of any given screen: primary actions, decided states, and key figures. Its rarity is the point — when everything is indigo, nothing is decided.
rules.name: The One Voice Rule

rules.body: The primary value never changes between themes; only neutrals and the focus ring remap. Brand recognition must survive a theme switch.
rules.name: The Same Brand Both Themes Rule

rules.body: Form fields render at 1rem on small screens and step down to 0.875rem at ≥768px, so mobile browsers never auto-zoom into a field.
rules.name: The No-Zoom Rule

rules.body: A page gets one Display title. Card and section titles use Headline or Title; they are not headings in the accessibility tree (CardTitle renders a div), so visual hierarchy must not imply document structure that is not there.
rules.name: The One Display Rule

rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state: hover, overlay, or focus.
rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
